'''''Pachycereus''''' is a [[genus]] of large [[cactus|cacti]] native to Central America and Mexico.<ref name=POWO_296878-2>{{Cite POWO|title=''Pachycereus'' (A.Berger) Britton & Rose|id=296878-2|access-date=2023-10-29|mode=cs1}}</ref> They form large [[shrub]]s or small [[tree]]s up to {{Convert abbreviated|15|m}} tall, with stout stems up to {{Convert abbreviated|1|m}} in diameter.  ''Pachycereus'' comes from the ancient Greek {{lang|grc|παχύς}} ({{lang|grc-Latn|pachys}}) meaning "thick" and the Latin {{lang|la|cereus}} meaning "torch".

''P. pringlei'' is the tallest cactus species in the world, with a maximum recorded height of {{Convert abbreviated|19.2|m}}.<ref>Salak, M. (2000). In search of the tallest cactus. ''Cactus and Succulent Journal'' 72 (3).</ref>

===Synonymy===
These genera have been brought into [[synonym (taxonomy)|synonymy]] with ''Pachycereus'' by some sources,{{citation needed|date=October 2023}} although {{As of|2023|October|lc=yes}}, not by Plants of the World Online:<ref name=POWO_296878-2/>
*''Lemaireocereus'' <small>[[Nathaniel Lord Britton|Britton]] & [[Joseph Nelson Rose|Rose]]</small>
*''Marginatocereus'' <small>([[Backeb.]]) Backeb.</small>

Species that may be placed in ''Pachycereus'' include:
*''Pachycereus hollianus'' <small>(F.A.C.Weber ex J.M.Coult.) Buxb.</small> = ''[[Lemaireocereus hollianus]]''<ref name=POWO_179823-2>{{Cite POWO|title=''Pachycereus hollianus'' (F.A.C.Weber ex J.M.Coult.) Buxb..|id=179823-2|access-date=2023-10-29|mode=cs1}}</ref>
*''Pachycereus lepidanthus'' <small>(Eichlam) Britton & Rose</small> = ''[[Lemaireocereus lepidanthus]]''<ref name=POWO_179824-2>{{Cite POWO|title=''Pachycereus lepidanthus'' (Eichlam) Britton & Rose|id=179824-2|access-date=2023-10-29|mode=cs1}}</ref>
*''Pachycereus militaris'' <small>(Audot) D.R.Hunt</small> = ''[[Mitrocereus militaris]]''<ref name=POWO_281915-2>{{Cite POWO|title=''Pachycereus militaris'' (Audot) D.R.Hunt|id=281915-2|access-date=2023-10-29|mode=cs1}}</ref>
